svg.title: GRID 100 — Craft — Blueprint (frame 04 of 05)
svg.desc: Design blueprint for the 100 GRID banknote: final note, theme, key elements, wireframe, symbol construction, colour system, patterns, SVG layers and specifications.

g.text: Craft is the value of finishing: every scale looked after, including the ones nobody checks.
The 100 note is a carpet divided by three, three times. The shape of the hole alternates with every scale, so no
level repeats the one above it. The same rule lays out the whole note: a sample sheet of nine finished cells.
3 × 3 × 3 subdivision: 1 circle, 8 squares, 64 circles. 73 holes, 512 solid cells.
The hole alternates with every scale, so no level imitates the one above.
The right side is a 3 × 3 sheet, cells 292 × 200, numerals across the middle row.
The carpet repeats at one third scale inside its own centre: craft within craft.
Rulers on the carpet carry ticks at 27, 9 and 3 divisions, longest at the thirds.
FLAT-COLOUR SEPARATION · ONE PLATE PER ROLE

g.text: CARE ABOUT EVERY DETAIL CARE ABOUT EVERY DETAIL CARE ABOUT EVERY DETAIL CARE ABOUT EVERY DETAIL CARE ABOUT EVERY DETAIL CARE ABOUT EVERY DETAIL CARE ABOUT EVERY DETAIL
Seven flat fills, no gradients, no transparency, no effects. Every overprint is an
explicit colour layer; every pattern uses a colour from this palette only.
SECTION E · P01 – P08 · HIGHLIGHT = IN USE
SECTION B · L01 – L08 · NAMED GROUPS
Border, keylines, ruler band, corner details
Colour blocks and the large geometric composition
Guilloché, contour, hatching, micro-grids, dot systems
The denomination symbol and its construction
Watermark window, repeated symbol, supporting forms
Denomination, GRID, title, phrase, serials, microcopy
Thread, tactile code, latent image, registration, micro-elements
50 px sides · 75 px rails · 26 px frame
